limitations: Closed-form estimate omits solder mask, conductor trapezoid and finite/coplar ground geometry.
JLC calculator uses nominal external1oz=1.6mil and solder mask parameters; its field-solver result has not been obtained.
External adjacent GND pours should stand back >=0.5mm from long USB pair; keep other signal tracks away where practical.
Factory must verify 90ohm USB +/-10% and 50ohm SD against selected stackup before manufacturing; no manufacturing order or guaranteed impedance claim.
